title: PAE Registry relationship row, version 1
description: One row of meta/registry/relationships.tsv. The four reorganization semantics stay distinct: a move preserves identity (previous_path), while superseded_by / merged_into / split_into describe a DIFFERENT identity replacing or absorbing this one.

object_ref.description: A UID for resource targets; a repo-relative path for document, collection and previous_path targets.

evidence.description: The repository file this edge was derived from. Copy edges come only from meta/VENDORED.tsv, never from content similarity.
